To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have computed the S3 partition functions for the ABJM theories with k = 1,..., 19 and N = 1,... 19, and that we have numerically determined the membrane 1 instanton coefficient for the ABJM theory with k = 2 and N = 2.
we compute the S3 partition functions of ABJM theory for a wide range of parameters, including all N = 1 cases, and we determine the coefficient of membrane instantons in these cases.
we have computed the S3 partition functions of the ABJM theory for N = 1,…,19 and k = 1.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the exact computation of physical quantities of supersymmetric gauge theories.
the computation of the partition function for the ABJM theory on a sphere.
the study of the exact partition functions of the ABJM and ABJ theories, as well as the study of their instanton corrections.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we find the partition function to be a polynomial of degree 2N - 1, whose leading coefficient equals 2N -1, and whose coefficients are given by a rational function of π-1.
the exact partition functions of the ABJM theory are polynomials in π-1.
the exact ABJM partition function on S3 can be written in terms of a finite sum of rational functions of the form (1 + π-1)k/(1 + π-2)l, with coefficients that are rational numbers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ABJM theory is a conformal field theory in the large-N limit.
the exact partition function is a polynomial of order N in π-1 and its coefficient is a rational function of N.

the partition function can be expressed as an infinite series of integrals, which we evaluate exactly using the thermodynamic Bethe ansatz (TBA).
